c5_commit_mode_reading.basis: tools/research_dispatch.py verify_archive (line 1771 onwards): for binding_mode 'commit' (the default) it computes the archive commit's changed paths against its first parent (_changed_paths, line 1865) and requires them to equal the declared source and archive paths exactly; any declared path not changed by that commit is reported 'missing' and the archive fails. A file committed earlier and unchanged therefore cannot be bound by a commit-mode archive. The only content-only path in commit mode is the fallback taken when commit_sha does not resolve or is not an ancestor of HEAD (_verify_content_only), which does not apply to a reachable archive commit. content_first and content_at_commit bind declared bytes from a tree instead (lines 1832-1863), so TASK-20261002-5e1246 (content_first) can bind them.
